scientific_rationale: Single registered factor change: region_id from F_b011_s030__reference to F_b011_s030__G06, holding operator=pointwise, controller=unit_rms, dose, window [0.1,0.5], target_schedule=fixed, representation=bridge, teacher_time=0.5 and native protocol fixed. G06 is a source terminal node (single_b011_final_030) with 40 same-root and 0 same-graph controls; its observed_local_point_moments are unweighted source local-point targets in actual_teacher_time_world_A at time 0.5, distinct from Gaussian whole-cloud discovery fields. The atom_slots change from the parent's 20-slot set to the 8-slot G06 support is the region's own support definition, not an independent operator or dose change. Prior from-zero geometry-imitation rounds (R03, R04, R05, R07, R07_v2, R08_v2, R09_v2, R10_v2, R11_v2, R12_v2, R13_v2, R14_v2) lowered the tail versus the reference parent while several reached high boundary attainment and high final native_element_fraction; those are heterogeneous interventions on a reused prior pool, not independent replicates, and no aggregate causal attribution is available. This run tests whether the shared pointwise imitation failure is region-conditioned by moving to an untested region with the parent operator. It is a zero-generation functional response check, not proof of efficacy; source layout score 8.704859 is not a generated score forecast.
